newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares hit new highs on U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares hit new highs on U.S. jobs data.

text.p: Swedish shares hit new highs late Friday afternoon as weaker than expected U.S. jobs data reversed a slight rise in debt yields and a wave of optimism broke over Europe's stock markets.
The all-share index closed at 2,107.73, rising 1.03 percent on the day and topping the previous life high of 2,097.48 recorded on Wednesday. Turnover was moderate to good at 3.80 billion crowns.
Drugs group Astra climbed seven crowns to 296, contributing to a two percent rise in the drugs index. Pharmacia & Upjohn rise 4.5 crowns to 278.
Analysts said Astra was one of few pharmaceuticals stocks that has not risen to its full potential.
Ericsson shook off early losses to close one crown higher at 169.5, tailing Nokia which rose in Helsinki after the Finnish company's TDMA contract with the U.S AT&T on Thursday.
Interest was keen in forestry group AssiDoman, which rose 2.50 crowns to 165.50 in turnover of 132 million crowns. Several brokerages have said they regard AssiDoman as undervalued.
Next week's developments will be governed by Astra and Wall street, brokers said.
"Optimism is beginning to ebb now. It's not quite as attractive to buy Swedish engineering and forestry stocks if the U.S. economy starts to turn down," one broker said.
